name: Four Seasons Resort Anguilla
insider_take: This pristine Caribbean sanctuary sits on one of Anguilla's most coveted stretches of powder-soft sand, where turquoise waters meet world-class luxury.
whats_special: The resort occupies prime real estate on Barnes Bay, featuring dramatic clifftop villas and beachfront accommodations. Anguilla boasts 33 beaches along just 35 square miles, and this Four Seasons claims one of the most spectacular. The island is also a culinary hotspot with more restaurants per capita than almost anywhere in the Caribbean.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's Bamboo Bar - it's perched right on the cliff edge and offers unobstructed views of St. Martin's twinkling lights across the channel.
dont_miss: The resort's signature snorkeling experience at nearby Little Bay, where you can explore underwater caves and vibrant coral reefs. Also, time your visit during the full moon for the island's famous beach barbecues that happen naturally along the shoreline.
pros: Pristine white sand beaches with crystal-clear Caribbean waters
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
Spacious oceanfront villas with private pools and butler service
World-class spa and wellness facilities with ocean views
cons: Remote Caribbean location requires connecting flights
